Here are the extracted quantitative parameters and values from the text:

1. Cut-off for positive cells: 1% positive cells.
2. Gentamycin concentration in culture medium: 100 μg/ml.
3. Fetal calf serum concentration in cocultures: 10%.
4. Culture medium volume per well in 24-well plates: 1 ml.
5. Exogenous cytokines concentration: 50 ng/ml.
6. Idarubicin concentrations: 0.1 μM and 0.01 μM.
7. Cytarabine concentrations: 1 μM and 0.1 μM.
8. Cell density for proliferation in suspension cultures: 5×10^4 cells/well.
9. Medium volume for proliferation in suspension cultures: 150 μl.
10. Incubation temperature: 37°C.
11. CO2 concentration in incubation atmosphere: 5%.
12. 3H-thymidine added after 6 days: 20 μl (37 kBq/well).
13. NaCl solution concentration for 3H-thymidine: 0.9%.
14. Pore diameter of semipermeable membrane in coculture: 0.4 μm.
15. Nonleukaemic cells seeded in lower compartment: 10^4 cells in 1 ml.
16. Leukaemia blasts added to upper chamber: 10^6 cells in 0.5 ml.
17. Incubation duration for cocultures: 7 days.
18. 3H-thymidine added for cell proliferation analysis: 280 kBq/well in 150 μl saline.
19. Trypsin–EDTA solution volume for nonleukaemic cells: 300 μl/well.
20. Aliquot volume for nuclear radioactivity assay: 50 μl for leukaemic cells, 70 μl for nonleukaemic cells.
21. Native human AML cells in T cell activation: 1×10^6 cells.
22. Normal bone marrow stromal cells in T cell activation: 1×10^4 cells.
23. Normal PBMC in T cell activation: 5×10^4 cells.
24. Anti-CD3 antibody dilution for T cell activation: 1:500.
25. Incubation duration for T cell activation: 7 days.
26. AML blasts for viability analysis: 2×10^6 cells in 2 ml medium per well.
27. Incubation durations for viability analysis: 24 and 48 hours.
28. AML blasts for cytokine secretion analysis: 1×10^6 AML blasts/ml.
29. Cell suspension volume for cytokine secretion analysis: 2 ml/well.
30. Incubation duration for cytokine secretion analysis: 48 hours.
31. Minimal detectable levels for cytokines:
    - IL1β: 0.8 pg/ml
    - IL6: 0.8 pg/ml
    - TNFα: 1.0 pg/ml
    - CXCL8: 3.5 pg/ml
    - CXCL9: 3.8 pg/ml
    - CXCL10: 1.7 pg/ml
    - CXCL11: 13.9 pg/ml
    - GM-CSF: 3 pg/ml
    - G-CSF: 8 pg/ml
